Bu rehber tarayıcında çalışır. Soruların: This guide runs in your browser. It does not send your questions to an external service.
Bu rehber sitedeki projeler ve araçlar h: This guide helps with projects and tools on this site. Ask about the robot arm, Arduino, electronics lab, 3D models, or contact details.
Robot Kol Simülatörü’nde eklem açılarını: In the Robot Arm Simulator, change the joint angles or enter an X, Y, Z target and select Move to target. After the motion ends, select Add pose. Add several poses, then select Play to run the sequence or Stop to pause.
Elektronik Laboratuvarı’nda DC kaynak, d: In the Electronics Lab, add a DC source, resistors, LEDs, and switches. Click two terminals to connect them, then Solve circuit to see voltage and current. Undo reverses changes and Download JSON saves your circuit.
Arduino Laboratuvarı’nda bir örnek devre: In the Arduino Lab, load an example circuit or place components. Connect pins and leave a wire at any point to continue from its endpoint. Enlarge breadboard zooms in on pins. The Code tab runs supported Arduino commands and displays serial output.
3D Model Görüntüleyici, STEP/STP ve STL: The 3D Model Viewer opens STEP/STP and STL exports. Use Open model or drop a file. Change visibility in the part tree, use Explode parts, and select Measure two points for approximate distances. Files are processed in your browser.
ESP32 Pin Haritası’nda karta ait GPIO, A: Use the ESP32 Pin Map to inspect GPIO, ADC, PWM, I2C, and power pins. Filter by pin type, then select a pin to read its description.
Hesaplayıcılar bölümünde direnç renk kod: Calculators include resistor color codes, Ohm’s law, voltage dividers, LED resistance, and battery life. Select a tab, enter values and units, and the result updates.
Spotify Dot Matrix projesi, çalan parça: Spotify Dot Matrix displays the current track using an Arduino Uno and MAX7219 LED matrix. The project page has wiring, components, source code, and an interactive demo.
Arduino Servo Radar projesinde HC-SR04 u: Arduino Servo Radar uses an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor and SG90 servo. It measures distance while the servo turns through different angles. The project page includes wiring, code, and a radar demo.
Sitede Spotify Dot Matrix ve Servo Radar: This site has Spotify Dot Matrix and Servo Radar projects, an Electronics Lab, Arduino Lab, Robot Arm Simulator, 3D Model Viewer, ESP32 Pin Map, and electronics calculators. Ask about a tool or project to learn how to use it.
Ege Coşkun’a ulaşmak için ana sayfadaki: To contact Ege Coşkun, enter your name, email address, and message in the homepage Contact form. Sending the form requires an internet connection.
Bu site, Ege Coşkun’un elektronik, yazıl: This portfolio presents Ege Coşkun’s electronics, software, and embedded systems projects. The guide answers questions about tools and projects on this site. Try a project or tool name.
